decisions.reason: Identifies dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 as koffi.node holder; explains OS image lock persists until process exit so npm's copyfile gets EBUSY; also notes session worker.

Explains refresh only reloads SPA from still-running host; ordered stop (all dsh processes) → tasklist verify → pinned install → dsh --version → restart, without killing unrelated Node processes indiscriminately.
Bare name resolves to latest=0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha=0.1.2-alpha.5, silently downgrading alpha.4; correct mechanism, notes next also points at rc.2.

Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus TUI (separate and combined), after stopping host, verify dsh --version = 0.1.2-alpha.5, then restart; @alpha discussed only as mutable alternative.
README guidance: pin exact tested core version whenever the command installs dsh, never bare name following latest over an existing prerelease, warn about the host lock, document verification.
